settings.description: Gets downstream APIs keyed by an application-owned name.

semanticConstraints: Endpoints/base addresses must be absolute HTTPS without query/fragment. Loopback HTTP is accepted only in Development with the explicit development override.
Named registration keys must not be blank and are compared ordinally.
Required string settings must not be empty or whitespace.
Configuration is metadata only; token clients and downstream requests are never initialized or executed by export.
TokenExchange mode requires at least one nonblank Audience or Resource to downscope the delegated token.
A nonnull Resource must be an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URI; it is not the downstream base-address transport setting.
Named TokenRegistration must be supplied; resolving the actual selected token source is a separate composition responsibility.
